request.query: Nonzero image integer absolute value at least one in ordered field polynomial evaluation

items.name: one_le_pow_mul_abs_eval_div
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|

items.name: AbsoluteValue.ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_5} {S : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : PartialOrder S]
  (abv : AbsoluteValue R S) {x : R}, x ≠ 0 → abv x ≠ 0

items.name: minpoly.aeval_ne_zero_of_dvdNotUnit_minpoly
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Ring B] [inst_2 : Algebra A B] {x : B} {a : Polynomial A},
  IsIntegral A x → a.Monic → DvdNotUnit a (minpoly A x) → (Polynomial.aeval x) a ≠ 0

items.name: Irreducible.aeval_ne_zero_of_natDegree_ne_one
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : Ring S] [inst_3 : Algebra R S] [FaithfulSMul R S]
  {p : Polynomial R},
  Irreducible p → p.natDegree ≠ 1 → ∀ {x : S}, x ∈ (algebraMap R S).range → (Polynomial.aeval x) p ≠ 0

items.name: Polynomial.tendsto_abv_aeval_atTop
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {k : Type u_3} {α : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Ring A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R A] [inst_3 : Field k] [inst_4 : LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] (abv : A → k)
  [IsAbsoluteValue abv] (p : Polynomial R),
  0 < p.degree →
    (algebraMap R A) p.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 →
      ∀ {l : Filter α} {z : α → A},
        Filter.Tendsto (abv ∘ z) l Filter.atTop →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun x => abv ((Polynomial.aeval (z x)) p)) l Filter.atTop

items.name: Polynomial.isProperMap_eval
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : NormedRing R] [IsAbsoluteValue norm] [ProperSpace R] (p : Polynomial R),
  0 < p.degree → IsProperMap fun x => Polynomial.eval x p
